before: The commentary says God knows what is open and hidden and places a nearly hidden event in Moses' scene; Moses distinguishes secret things belonging to God from revealed things given to Israel, marking a related boundary without equating the subjects.
after: The commentary says God knows what is open and hidden and places a nearly hidden event in Moses' scene; Moses distinguishes secret things belonging to God from revealed things given to Israel, marking a related boundary without equating the subjects.
changes.reason: The hidden/revealed distinction is WLC Deuteronomy 29:28, corresponding to English 29:29.
